::: remark

A measure assigns a size to each set in a
[collection of sets](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-collection):
how many elements it has, how long it is, or how likely it is.
These notes build measures from $\sigma$-algebras and additivity,
using the definitions on the [Sets](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html) and [Functions](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html) pages.
One kind of measure, the probability measure (@def-probability-measure),
is the starting point of the Morrison Lab's probability notes
([probability measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability)).

:::
